request: Build a small Jac web app for short memos with visibility levels. Each user writes memos that are private (owner only), workspace (any signed-in user) or public (anyone, including anonymous visitors). The feed and single-memo lookups only show what the viewer may see, and only the owner can change a memo's visibility or delete it.
acceptance: An anonymous viewer's feed contains only public memos, and fetching a private memo by id returns 'not found', not 'forbidden'.
A signed-in non-owner sees workspace and public memos but cannot edit or delete them.
When the owner changes a memo from public to private, it disappears from every other viewer's feed.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
